report_title: Phase 6.2.30A — Human Content Quality Audit Report (50 Locked Records)
confirmation_statement: Phase 6.2.30A performed an independent content quality audit only. Zero production/staging database records were mutated, zero lifecycle statuses were changed, and no review approvals were executed.

audit_records.current_meaning_en: a special disposition (as if from a divine source) to pursue a particular course

audit_records.current_example_sentence: he was disappointed that he had not heard the Call
audit_records.reviewer_reason: Obscure theological sense ("divine vocation/calling") assigned to basic A1 noun instead of everyday telephone call or shout; Thai meaning is an empty generic template; capitalized example sentence refers to religious calling.
audit_records.suggested_action: Place on HOLD; re-anchor canonical OEWN synset to everyday communication sense (phone call / shout), author accurate Thai translation, and provide learner-appropriate example sentence.

audit_records.current_meaning_en: discover or come upon accidentally, suddenly, or unexpectedly; catch somebody doing something or in a certain state

audit_records.suggested_action: Place on HOLD; resolve synset conflict by selecting either physical catching or capturing with matching definition, translation, and example.
